observations: Photo 0 shows a Nikon camera body mounted on a rig/holder with a lens attached, plus multiple shipping boxes; the main box is heavily taped and shows wear.
Photo 1 shows the camera packaging/manual inserts inside an open box; no clear close-up of the camera body controls or screen.
Photo 2 shows additional items packed in bubble wrap inside the box; no clear view of the camera body serial/model plate.

claims.evidence: No photo shows the Nikon D750 model marking/label or the camera body itself clearly enough to confirm D750.
Photos mainly show boxes/packaging; no close-up of the camera body for condition assessment.
No photo/video of the camera powering on, shutter actuation, autofocus, or image output.

risks.risk: Model mismatch (not actually D750, or different Nikon body).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the camera body model text/label (e.g., on the front/top/bottom plate) and the serial number area.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic Nikon DSLR body with unknown model/condition (worst case for buyer).

risks.risk: Not working / faults (no power, shutter issues, dead sensor, broken buttons/ports).
risks.proof: Short video: power on + menu navigation + take a photo + playback on the rear screen (showing a saved image).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed working (worst case).

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories (battery, charger, body cap, cables) or lens not included despite 'Body' wording.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out on a table, with a checklist (battery model, charger, straps, manuals, any lens).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as body-only with missing/uncertain accessories (worst case).

risks.risk: Damage from shipping/handling (cracks, bent mount, loose shutter mechanism).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lens mount area, hot shoe, ports, and any visible cracks/dents; plus a test video after mounting a lens.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged/needs service (worst case).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the camera body showing the exact model name 'D750' and the serial number/label.
Video test: power on, menu works, autofocus (if lens mounted), shutter click, and a captured image shown in playback.
Photo of all included items (battery, charger, cables, manuals, and confirm whether any lens is included).
Close-ups of the lens mount, hot shoe, ports, and rear screen for cracks/scratches.
response.reason: The photos show mostly packaging and a rigged camera/lens setup, but they do not clearly confirm the exact Nikon D750 model or demonstrate that the camera is working. Without proof, the safest pricing depends on worst-case unknown model/condition.
